author: Inside Edition
description: An American serving a prison sentence in Asia fears he may not make it home. Jarred Shaw is a native of Dallas, Texas. He currently resides behind bars in Tangerang, Indonesia. That's because he was caught receiving more than 100 cannabis gummies in the mail. The package was intercepted by law enforcement and Shaw was arrested. Shaw spoke to InsideEdition Digital from prison last month. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: American Imprisoned In Indonesia Says His Chronic Illness Is Getting Worse

author: Inside Edition
description: The luxury cruise ship at the center of a hantavirus outbreak has been evacuated. The MV Hondius docked at the Spanish island of Tenerife over the weekend. All passengers disembarked and boarded planes sent by their respective governments to bring them home. The US Department of Health and Human Services says 18 Americans are now being cared for in the National Quarantine Unit at the University of Nebraska Medical Center. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Americans Arrive In Nebraska For Quarantine After Leaving Hantavirus Cruise
